implication: HOT spam dominates tx count; Intents dominates settlement weight — L1 tx recovery would not automatically fix fee coverage
read: HOT ~34.5% tx vs Intents ~13.2% at matched gas — Intents is ~2.61× heavier per gas unit inverted (HOT has more tx/gas). Fee coverage wall ~42.8% is an Intents/capture problem, not an L1 spam problem. Exploratory.
